s_3229cce1: Endaweni yokufumana abasebenzisi abafanayo, le modeli ifumana izinto ezifanayo. Ireyithingi engekhoyo iqikelelwa kwizinto umsebenzisi ekujoliswe kuzo esele zithelekelele.
s_3b7aa001: Kuphela ngabamelwane abareyithe ikhosi ekujoliswe kuyo abanegalelo. Ukufana kolo qikelelo akubandakanyi ikhosi ekujoliswe kuyo, ngoko ke ukukala kwayo akunakuvuza kuthelekiso.
s_4edac776: I-cosine e-Plain kwi-positive 1-5 yokulinganisa inokwenza abasebenzisi abanomdla ohlukeneyo bajonge ngokufanayo. Hlola amanani ekwabelwana ngawo kunye nokulinganisa kommelwane.
s_5bf9cece: Ibar ephezulu enomlinganiselo omnye okwabelwana ngawo kuphela bubungqina obubuthathaka kunobunye obuxhaswe ngamareyithingi amaninzi okwabelwana ngawo.
s_728fd035: Ukuhlelwa kweseti yedatha kubonakala kwiSeti yedatha kunye nokuJonga. Yakha kwakhona kuloliwe ukuze ubabandakanye kwintelekelelo.
s_85423a1f: Yakha imodeli ukuze ubone inyathelo ngalinye lokulungiselela.
s_9074679f: Ukubona kusebenzisa olu hlela ngoku. Yakha kwakhona imodeli kuloliwe ukuze uwasebenzisele ukuthelekelela.
s_98390447: Emva kokwakha, vula intelekelelo yokuhlola izinto ezikuluhlu, abamelwane abanikelayo, kunye nokubala okulinganiselweyo okuphakathi.
s_a95670b1: Imodyuli yeNgcebiso yesikhangeli esisebenzisanayo kuphela eneseti yedatha yalapha ekhaya, ulawulo, ukubonwa, ukulinganisa, kunye nokuthunyelwa ngaphandle.
s_c5b3c07b: Imiba yomsebenzisi P kunye neemeko zento Q ziivektha ezincinci. Imveliso yabo yamachaphaza yakha kwakhona ukalisho ngalunye, ngelixa uhlengahlengiso lugcina izinto ekukhuleni kakhulu.
s_d4d8bbe8: Umsebenzisi omtsha okanye ikhosi inokuba nobungqina obuncinci bokucebisa.
s_d5c89676: Cacisa ukuba iireyithingi ekwabelwana ngazo ziba ngamanqaku afanayo, emva koko usebenzise ubungqina bommelwane ukuthethelela isindululo.
s_d7378823: Akukho nto ingalinganiswanga inobungqina bommelwane. Yongeza iireyithingi kwiSeti yedatha kwaye uyakhe kwakhona.
s_d924d5d4: I-tab yentelekelelo isebenzisa umfanekiso okhawulezayo wokala. Yakha imodeli ukusuka kwiseti yedatha ye-matrix yangoku ukufumana iingcebiso.
